topics.title: Nerandomilast (1305-0052) SSc Ph3 – China CTA Strategy & Protocol Update

background.text: CDE pre-IND feedback received Nov 10, 2025. Team proposed to submit China CTA after FDA feedback on US CTA due to potential risks with China CTA/EC approvals. TDO finalized Nov 26; study design revised Dec 2, country allocation adjusted to 45 subjects from 25 sites (total sample size 448). Huashan hospital & BI meeting held Dec 1.
background.quote:
CDE feedback for pre-IND was received on Nov 10th. Considering about the potential risks with China CTA/EC approvals, team proposed to submit China CTA after FDA feedback on US CTA, which has been endorsed by CEC in Nov and aligned with global ET.
TDO was finalized on Nov 26th . On Dec 2nd. The study design was revised. Country allocation for China has been adjusted to 45 subjects from 25 sites (total sample size has been adjusted to 448 subjects).

background.text: Study 1305-0052 SSc Ph3 current status: Pre-IND feedback received; best case NDA approval US: Feb 2031, CN: Jul 2031.
